oats.identity: Kroger 100% Whole Grain Old Fashioned Oats, UPC 0001111076655, 42 oz; Whole Grain Rolled Oats.

oats.limits: Original online label, rounding retained. Actual package can differ; cross-contact unverified. NOT certified gluten-free. No newly fetched price used.
